places.name: Haller Park
places.description: A former quarry turned wildlife sanctuary, also known as the Bamburi Nature Trail, with hippos, giraffes, tortoises and shaded walking paths.
places.alt: Two hippos with their heads above the water

places.name: Nyali Beach
places.description: A long stretch of white sand and turquoise water, popular for morning walks, swimming at high tide and fresh coconut.
places.alt: Aerial view of a white-sand beach and turquoise sea beside green forest

places.name: Bamburi Beach
places.description: A wide, quiet beach of soft white sand backed by palms, ideal for long walks along the shore.
places.alt: Empty white-sand beach with palm trees under a cloudy sky

places.name: Shanzu Beach
places.description: A relaxed beach just south of Mtwapa, where the tide goes far out and the reef is easy to explore at low tide.
places.alt: Palm trees lining a sandy beach at low tide

places.name: Fort Jesus
places.description: A 16th-century Portuguese fort and UNESCO World Heritage Site, with a museum covering centuries of coastal history.
places.alt: Thick stone walls of Fort Jesus above green trees

places.name: Mombasa Old Town
places.description: Narrow lanes, carved wooden doors and old Swahili houses. A guided walk is the easiest way to see the mosques and markets.
places.alt: Historic sepia photograph of a crowded street in Mombasa Old Town

places.name: Kilifi Coast
places.description: Palm-fringed beaches and calm waters north of Mtwapa, a short drive up the coast road for a quieter day by the sea.
places.alt: Palm trees, beach loungers and boats on the sea at Kilifi

places.name: North Coast Beach Bandas
places.description: Thatched makuti shelters on the sand, a classic spot for cool drinks, fresh seafood and sea views.
places.alt: Thatched beach shelters framing palm trees and the ocean
